# Zyren

> Native Dart 3D with an optional Flutter host. Local workspace API 0.1.0.

## Authoring

- [Agent guide](packages/zyren_devtools/guides/AGENT_GUIDE.md): Current imports, lifecycle, coordinates and checks.
- [Compiled recipe](packages/zyren_devtools/example/inspection_recipe.dart): Scene inspection setup tested in CI.
- [Core API](packages/zyren/lib/zyren.dart): Public Dart exports.

## Live diagnostics

- [AI setup](packages/zyren_devtools/guides/README.md): CLI, MCP and local debug bridge setup.
- [Devtools](packages/zyren_devtools/README.md): Inspector plugin and optional tools.
